title: Hold a water and sewerage licence
what: Own or operate water or sewerage infrastructure that serves others only under a licence.

sources.title: Water and Sewerage Industry Act 2008 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not – (a) own or operate water infrastructure or sewerage infrastructure used for the provision of water services or sewerage services to another person;
